flagged.title: Sociological Theories of the Role of the Family
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly identifies the New Right as a conflict perspective ('our conflict challengers' at 01:36 and 'conflict theorists' at 09:18), which is a major theoretical error in GCSE Sociology that would lose marks in an exam.

mark_affecting.quote: But Marxism, feminism, and the New Right, well those are our conflict challengers, and we're going to swap our lenses to see exactly what they see.
